subject.title: fix(openai): enable prompt cache keys for Azure

question: Should generic Azure AI Foundry hostname families automatically imply Azure OpenAI prompt-cache support, or should automatic behavior be restricted to positively identified Azure OpenAI routes while other Foundry deployments use the existing explicit compat opt-in?
rationale: The repository must choose between broad convenience and preserving request compatibility for multi-model Foundry endpoints; source-level hostname matching cannot safely infer the deployed model’s parameter contract.

options.title: Restrict automatic defaults
options.body: Auto-enable cache parameters only for established Azure OpenAI routes and require the existing compat flag for generic Foundry deployments.

options.title: Keep broad hostname defaults
options.body: Treat every matching Foundry hostname as cache-capable and accept that operators of unsupported deployments must explicitly disable the default.

recommendation.title: Restrict automatic defaults
recommendation.body: Auto-enable cache parameters only for established Azure OpenAI routes and require the existing compat flag for generic Foundry deployments.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged compat work established the explicit override that is the relevant compatibility boundary.
